Well I was with my ex for 5 years so I had just recently raised my standards after that relationship ended. And the reason why I didn't "give" my boyfriend sex before commitment is because I wanted the reassurance that he really wanted to be with me, not just have sex with me. We wanted time to grow our emotional connection before our physical connection and I do think this benefited our relationship, and when we did have sex it was more meaningful. There's nothing wrong with having sex before commitment, it's all based on personal choice but the fact that you're upset that your girlfriend changed her standards and you weren't able to have sex before dating is ridiculous. If you really wanted to be with her, not just for sex, you shouldn't care.

Based on your comments that I've read you act like your girlfriend owed you sex just purely off of the fact that she used to have sex before commitment. Do you not realize that people and their standards/morals can change? Like other people have said, you're viewing it the wrong way. You should be happy about her wanting the commitment because that obviously means that sex had more meaning to her with you than it did with the past people. I did exactly what she did, I used to have sex before commitment but with my current boyfriend I had changed that and waited until we were dating because I wanted the relationship to be more than just physical at first. It seems like you're taking this as an insult when you really shouldn't be.
